name: Freetown Christiania
description: A red field bearing three yellow discs in a horizontal row.
history: Flag of Freetown Christiania, the self-governing intentional community founded in 1971 in a former military barracks in Copenhagen. The three discs are commonly said to represent the dots of the three 'i's in 'Christiania'.

features.role: three discs — the dots of the i's in Christiania
